Subject: Renewal + EU private: request to add hot-standby cluster and extend term

Hi Priyom,

As Mediversal approaches our renewal (Oct 15), we want to align the contract with two requests from our infra and security teams: add a dedicated hot-standby cluster in the EU region for disaster recovery and extend the term from 12 to 24 months to lock pricing for the next two years.

Key asks:
- Provision an additional private cluster (3 x A100 equivalent) in eu-west-1 with network isolation (VPC peering + strict SG rules).
- Hot-standby must be kept staggered and ready for fast failover (cold-to-warm in under 10 minutes).
- Update terms: 24 months, include an SLA credit carve-out for failover windows and a one-time charge for the standby cluster provisioning.
- We will need SOC2 artifacts and a short network topology to share with our auditors.

Can you send a short proposal (cost delta, timeline, any required approvals)? Also looping our procurement contact Sven (cc).

Thanks,
Aurelia
VP Platform, Mediversal

Aurelia — thanks for the clear ask. We can absolutely support a hot-standby cluster in eu-west-1 and the 24-month term. High-level proposal below; I'll follow with a short SOW and cost worksheet attached.

Proposal summary:
- Standby cluster: 3 x A100-equivalent nodes (reserved instances) deployed in your private VPC via our Private offering. Network isolation and dedicated routing will be configured; cross-account peering or Transit Gateway options available.
- Failover target: warm standby with automated KV-cache priming; expected RTO (failover availability) ~8–12 minutes depending on session size.
- Billing: one-time provisioning fee + monthly reserved capacity charge. Estimated delta: $45,000 one-time + $28,000/month (subject to final sizing).
- Term: 24 months with a 10% discount on monthly reserved capacity vs 12-month pricing. SLA exception: we can include a failover SLA credit formula tied to measured RTOs (details in SOW).
- Timeline: 4–6 weeks from signed SOW + network review.

Next steps:
1) Internal approval for pricing and SLA language (stephanie / aditya)
2) I will send SOW_draft_v2.pdf and SOC2_summary.pdf for your audit team
3) On signature, we schedule kick-off and network runbook review with Mediversal infra

Cc'd Stephanie for pricing confirmation and Aditya for any capacity/ops concerns.

-Priyom
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
